sentences.text:
Applicant :- Vinay Yadav
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home U.P. Civil Secrett. Lko.

And 3 Ot Counsel for Applicant :- Indrajeet,Amit Kumar Srivastava Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Subhash Vidyarthi,J.
Heard Mr. Indrajeet, learned counsel for the applicant, Mr. Jayant Singh Tomar, learned A.G.A.-I for the State and perused the records.
The instant application has been filed seeking release of the applicant on bail in Case Crime No. 145 of 2022, under Sections 363, 366, 376 (3) I.P.C. and Section 3/4 of Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012, registered at Police Station Kaiserganj, District Bahraich.

entities.text: Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: The aforesaid case has been registered on the basis of an F.I.R. lodged on 10.05.2022 alleging that the applicant had enticed away the informant's sister aged about 15 years.

In her statement recorded under Section 161 Cr.P.C. the alleged victim stated that she is aged about 19 years and that she had gone with the applicant out of her own will; that she married the applicant and is living with him as his wife and that she wants to live with the applicant only.
The victim was taken to the medico legal examination, but she declined to undergo the same.

sentences.text: 1 A supplementary affidavit has been filed on behalf of the applicant annexing therewith a copy of the birth certificate of the alleged victim in which her date of birth has been mentioned as 19.04.2003.

In the affidavit filed in support of bail application it has been stated that the applicant is innocent,
he has been falsely implicated in the present case and he has no criminal history.
The learned A.G.A. has opposed the prayer for bail but could not dispute the aforesaid aspects of the matter.

Having considered the aforesaid facts and circumstances of the case and keeping in view the fact that the alleged victim has stated in her statement under Section 161 Cr.P.C. that she is aged about 19 years; that from the birth certificate annexed with the supplementary affidavit also, it appears that she is a major; that the victim has stated that she has gone with the applicant out of her own freewill; that the applicant has no previous criminal history and he is languishing in jail since 13.06.2022 and without making any observation, which may affect the merits of the case, I am satisfied that the applicant is entitled to be enlarged on bail in the aforesaid case crime.
Accordingly, this bail application stands allowed.
